items.expectedStem: How many indicators are used in the Human Development Index (HDI)?
items.explanation: UNDP specifies four underlying indicators: life expectancy, expected years of schooling, mean years of schooling, and GNI per capita. These represent three dimensions, which the existing explanation confused with indicators.

items.expectedStem: Which one of the following most appropriately describes the nature of Green Revolution of late sixties of 20th century?
items.explanation: Both the high-yielding-varieties programme and the associated seed–fertiliser–water package describe the Green Revolution; “most appropriately” does not make C uniquely correct over D.

items.expectedStem: The rate at which a central bank lends money to commercial banks is called -
items.explanation: Both bank rate and repo rate can describe a rate at which RBI lends to commercial banks. Repo lending is secured by a repurchase agreement; bank rate is a broader statutory lending or rediscount rate. The stem gives no tenor or transaction type to distinguish A from B.

items.expectedStem: Which country has officially become the world’s first Cashless country?
items.explanation: Sweden is highly digital but has not officially abolished cash or become a completely cashless country. Its central bank still treats notes and coins as legal tender and recorded cash purchases in 2025. No printed country is established as the world’s first officially cashless country.

items.expectedStem: No helmet, no petrol rule comes into force in _____________
items.explanation: The existing Gujarat key is an admitted guess. Contemporary reports document Andhra Pradesh introducing this rule in September 2017 and a Karnataka city enforcing it in February 2018. The stem gives no date or geographic level, so it cannot distinguish the printed states reliably.

items.expectedStem: In India, which body releases the Poverty Line estimates?
items.explanation: NITI Aayog publishes a National Multidimensional Poverty Index, but that is distinct from a monetary poverty line based on household consumption. India’s last official consumption-poverty-line estimates were released by the former Planning Commission. The wording “releases the Poverty Line estimates” therefore does not precisely fit the keyed NITI option.

items.expectedStem: Consider the following actions which the government can take: (i)Devaluing the domestic currency (ii)Reduction in export subsidy (iii)Adopting suitable policies which attract greater FDI and more funds from FIIs. Which of the above action/ actions can help in reducing the current account deficit?
items.explanation: Only devaluation can directly tend to narrow a current-account deficit by changing trade prices, subject to trade elasticities. FDI and foreign portfolio inflows are recorded in the financial account and can finance a current-account gap but do not reduce the deficit itself. Reducing export subsidies can weaken exports. No printed combination gives (i) alone.
